Reason: The CT images demonstrate extensive pneumomediastinum and subcutaneous emphysema extending into the neck (retropharyngeal space), with air clearly visible within the spinal canal (pneumorrhachis). This pattern is consistent with air tracking from the mediastinum/retropharyngeal space into the epidural space via the neural foramina, rather than direct trauma or esophageal perforation alone.
